si.t: A CSV file that lists the coordinates and IDs of stations for the SRP model run; precipitation and temperature data will be scraped for these locations
A CSV file that lists the IDs of RAWS stations; precipitation and temperature data will be scraped for these locations
A CSV file that lists the GHCND IDs of NOAA stations; precipitation and temperature data will be scraped for these locations
A CSV file that lists the IDs of CIMIS stations; precipitation and temperature data will be scraped for these locations
A text file that contains the CIMIS Web API key on the first line (without any spaces or extra characters)
A CSV file that lists the coordinates and IDs of stations for the PRMS model run; precipitation and temperature data will be scraped for these locations
Location of the source "SRPHM_update_ag" model folder; it will be copied into the "ProcessedData" folder temporarily for the model run
Location of the source "RR_PRMS" model folder; it will be copied into the "ProcessedData" folder temporarily for the model run

The path to the primary DAT file (in a CSV format) that will be input into PRMS; for the model run, this file will be copied and merged with (1) the downloaded meteorological data and (2) predictions for the remainder of the water year

The path to the primary DAT file (in a CSV format) that will be input into SRP; for the model run, this file will be copied and merged with (1) the downloaded meteorological data and (2) predictions for the remainder of the water year

The path to the DAT file (in a CSV format) containing forecasted values for the current water year (generated using SPI); for PRMS model runs early in the water year, these values are used for the rest of the water year that lacks meteorological data

The path to the DAT file (in a CSV format) containing forecasted values for the current water year (generated using SPI); for SRP model runs early in the water year, these values are used for the rest of the water year that lacks meteorological data
The location where a new folder will be created to store metadata as well as model inputs and outputs

A CSV file that lists the coordinates and IDs of PRISM grid cells that correspond to the PRMS model domain boundaries (Subbasins 1-22 of the Russian River); precipitation data will be scraped for these locations

A CSV file that lists the coordinates and IDs of PRISM grid cells that correspond to the SRP model domain boundaries (Subbasins 23-28 of the Russian River); precipitation data will be scraped for these locations

A CSV file that contains daily precipitation values for the PRMS model domain; these values should be averages of data from the PRISM grid cells that correspond to the model domain's boundaries (Subbasins 1-22 of the Russian River)

A CSV file that contains daily precipitation values for the SRP model domain; these values should be averages of data from the PRISM grid cells that correspond to the model domain's boundaries (Subbasins 23-28 of the Russian River)
A CSV file that contains reduction factors (in the form of decimal proportions) for each month and GAG file. The flow data output by SRP is reduced using these values.

A CSV file that contains the "Master Demand Table"--the final result of the SDA demand procedure; this dataset contains the average monthly usage of different water users and the subbasins in the Russian River where they are located

A folder that contains XLSX spreadsheets with historic estimates of PVP flows in the Russian River watershed; the most recent version of this spreadsheet is automatically extracted and applied in the modeling procedure

A folder that contains XLSX spreadsheets with future projections of PVP flows in the Russian River watershed; the most recent version of this spreadsheet is automatically extracted and applied in the modeling procedure
Either "Similar" or "Dry"; this references whether the values of a similar water year or a dry water year are used in the forecasted flows
Either "Var" or "NoVar"; this references whether PVP infrastructure variance is considered in the forecasted flows

An XLSX file that contains monthly evapotranspiration estimates for the Upper Russian River and Lower Russian River subbasins; these values are applied to the water supply values used in DWRAT, reducing water availability
A CSV file that specifies the interconnectivity between sub-basins in the Russian River watershed
This is an optional field that identifies another folder where archived files in the "HYDROLOGY_OUTPUT_LOCATION" directory will be copied to
